reviews.frank_statement: Higher-order Hyperposition semantics may matter to Frank, but that does not by itself require a physically native n-ary runtime backend.
reviews.counterhypothesis: A physically native n-ary backend is required to preserve all materially useful Frank higher-order semantics.
reviews.falsifier: Matched target execution showing every admissible pairwise/factorized lowering diverges from native n-ary on semantic projection, intervention response, GWT causal use or replay while native n-ary remains Pareto-acceptable.
independent_checks: Peixoto, Peel, Gross, De Domenico 2026 arXiv:2602.16937 supports graph-based representations of multivariate/higher-order interactions.
adversarial_checks: Preserve weighted/probabilistic/continuous counterexamples where the current finite latent-star result may fail.
Require semantic identity to remain stable across backend changes.
reviews.reason: Independent literature plus current local reduction evidence undermine a universal native-hyperedge requirement, but do not prove every Frank relation is safely lowerable.

reviews.frank_statement: A Hyperposition rewrite/cache result may depend on active, coordination or physical topology even when semantic topology is unchanged.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Existing state/execution/delivery generations already advance for every topology mutation that can change a Frank result, so per-plane dependency fingerprints are redundant.
reviews.falsifier: On frozen real Frank traces, compare the current V1.1-like fence, one coarse topology generation, bind-all-four fingerprints and typed scoped fingerprints under independent topology mutations; scoped certificates lose if no extra stale reuse is caught or if simpler fencing dominates on safety/cost/recovery.
independent_checks: Anderson et al. 2021 arXiv:2105.06712 tracks control/data dependencies for selective change propagation.
Budiu et al. arXiv:2203.16684 gives a general incrementalization framework for rich computations.
adversarial_checks: 100000-case same-generation topology mutation falsifier includes semantic-only, active, coordination, physical and mixed dependency classes.
Compare against a single coarse topology-generation counter, not only an obviously over-invalidating bind-all baseline.
reviews.reason: The local executable discriminator found a precise stale-reuse class in a V1.1-like key under declared-dependency truth, while independent incremental-computation work supports dependency tracking as a mechanism class. Target relevance remains unresolved and blocks promotion.

reviews.frank_statement: HyperMath rewrite law status is insufficient without material-read and topology-dependency closure.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Ordinary rewrite-law checking already subsumes all read-closure/topology validity requirements.
reviews.falsifier: Produce a law-valid rewrite whose output remains invariant under every undeclared material/topology mutation, or show the production compiler can derive complete closure without carrying explicit read-effect metadata.
independent_checks: Zhang et al. 2023 arXiv:2304.04332 supports incremental execution combined with equality-saturation/rewriting but does not establish Clay-specific safety.
adversarial_checks: The executable checker rejects a declared SEMANTIC-only scope when observed reads include ACTIVE.
Incomplete closure binds all four planes and blocks exact-rewrite admission.
reviews.reason: Current H7B evidence already rejects context smuggling; the new topology read-effect makes the same closure principle explicit for rewrite/cache validity.

reviews.frank_statement: Topology-read dependency semantics do not currently require a V18 source-grammar extension.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Programmers must explicitly annotate topology read effects in source syntax because post-parse TypedIR/type-effect analysis cannot derive or conservatively represent them.
reviews.falsifier: A concrete current Frank program whose required topology dependency cannot be represented or conservatively inferred in TypedIR/type-effect metadata without changing source grammar.
adversarial_checks: Implement the candidate entirely after parsing and require hidden-read rejection.
Keep V18 exact bytes frozen while running the structured frontend path separately.
reviews.reason: The current executable prototype represents and validates topology read effects entirely as post-parse compiler metadata, so changing V18 is unnecessary for this candidate. This does not preclude a future syntax feature if a concrete counterexample demands one.
